input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: thank you, and outstanding items
input.body:
Dear Anand,

Thank you for your reply. We have noted that the propanediol drum is 215 kg net, so RM-001 can be expressed in kg. Your 2-drum MOQ therefore equals 430 kg net.

The following items are still open.

1. Niacinamide (RM-003): the COA you sent is dated 10 March 2026 and is more than 6 months old. Please send a current COA for a recent batch, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date.
2. Safety Data Sheet (SDS): please provide the current SDS for each line, including the transport hazard class.
3. Suitability and regulation: please confirm that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp cosmetic use and permitted under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.
4. COA per line: please provide a COA from a recent batch for each line, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date.
5. Cold chain: please confirm you can deliver with an unbroken 2-8 °C cold chain, and describe your packaging and temperature logging.
6. OTIF: please state your on-time-in-full rate for these lines over the last 12 months, and your definition of on-time.
7. Late or short delivery: what remedy do you offer?
8. Need-by date: can you meet the need-by date of 20 December 2026 for the first delivery? If not, state your earliest date.
9. Incoterm: state the Incoterm and delivery point, and whether freight, insurance and packing are included. If not, state the amount.
10. Manufacturer status: are you the manufacturer for each line quoted? If not, name the manufacturer and country of manufacture.
11. Quotation footnote: your quotation refers to a footnote. Please restate its terms in writing so we can evaluate the quote.

Please reply by 14 November 2026.

Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care

input.summary: Tungabhadra Actives LLP (V02), contact Anand. Quote and niacinamide COA (dated 2026-03-10) received for RFx KPC-2026-014. Quote has a footnote, terms not yet restated; we asked them to restate it. Vendor replied: propanediol drum is 215 kg net, so RM-001 MOQ of 2 drums = 430 kg, resolved. Open: RM-003 COA older than 6 months (2 tries left). Unanswered: SDS (H1), suitability/Cosmetics Rules (H2), COA per line (B5), 2-8 C cold chain (F3), OTIF (I1), remedy (I2), need-by 20 Dec 2026 (E3), Incoterm (D2), manufacturer status (A2). Vendor has not been told of any award or volume. Reply requested by 14 Nov 2026.
